verdict.rationale: Docs confirm S3-compatible object storage for training data, checkpoints, and model weights, which is inherently decoupled from any GPU instance and thus persists across teardown [coreweave-docs-10]. However, there is no evidence of network-attached block/file storage (e.g., persistent volumes attachable to CKS nodes) or explicit language about volumes surviving pod/node rescheduling, which is what a developer expecting Kubernetes-native persistent storage would look for. Missing for 10: explicit persistent volume/PVC or network block storage documentation, independent confirmation of storage surviving instance teardown beyond object storage.
